mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 72 degrees with clear skies by City Hall and the moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The city has shared upcoming public meeting dates for the US 18/151 Corridor Study, which runs from Dodgeville to Fitchburg. These meetings will cover initial design concepts and allow for public feedback. Additionally, the city continues its regular engineering reporting through its contract with AECOM Inc.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac, enjoy pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or head to the Bogey Factory for trivia. Tomorrow, the festivities continue with the Main Street Trick or Treat and Thursday Night at Art House.

In our weekly report, on October 25, officers responded to a call regarding a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue. A 40-year-old man was found inside and was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the flavor of the day, Chocolate Heath Crunch. The shop is open until 10 PM tonight, so make sure to get there before they close.
